task_title: Fix append_board_task_completed.py TypeError on mixed-shape event ids
task_criteria: On a fixture board whose events.jsonl carries a mix of int, string and None ids: python3 append_board_task_completed.py <repo> <id> <tick> <commit> --summary s exits 0, appends its events with the next int id, and the row flips to complete; python3 -m py_compile clean; the mixed-shape fixture test is part of test_append_close_commit.py and passes. FAILURE_CONDITION: any PROOF command exits nonzero, the appended events carry non-int ids, an existing events.jsonl line is renumbered or rewritten, or the mixed-shape fixture test is absent from test_append_close_commit.py. PROOF: python3 -m py_compile coding-hermes-foreman/scripts/append_board_task_completed.py && python3 -m pytest coding-hermes-foreman/scripts/test_append_close_commit.py -q
